note: Both sets capture the same core facts: the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence example, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement with its condition. Both contain near-duplicate claims (the 40W incandescent and the vacancy-sensor requirement each appear twice), and B adds a third redundancy by listing the HARVEST HOME requirement twice, once without the Title 24 condition. Neither set extracts the LIGHTING LEVELS table (foot-candle levels and bulb counts per activity), so both are equally incomplete there. Set A is marginally better only because it carries one fewer redundant claim.
